replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, I often feel anxious when faced with complex math problems. My high neuroticism makes me worry about making mistakes, and my low conscientiousness means I sometimes avoid math tasks. Even simple calculations can stress me out sometimes.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried an AI math tutor app last year. It was helpful for basic arithmetic and algebra, but I found it confusing when it explained concepts like calculus. My high openness made me curious, but my low conscientiousness meant I didn't stick with it long enough to improve.
